summary: Tested new Creator Dashboard surface end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 new tests + 27/27 prior tests all pass (35 total). Frontend: full happy path validated — creator-header (name, IG handle, pending vetting badge), stats-panel (22.4k followers compact, live-stats note, niche chips cafe/brunch, base rate), applications section (2 rows with quoted_rate ₹7,500 + state-pill-applied, clicking row navigates to /campaigns/:id), upcoming-empty and payments-empty visible, header-edit-profile → /onboarding/creator, header-browse-campaigns → /campaigns. Non-creator (brand) hitting /dashboard sees the placeholder NonCreator layout with no creator-header/stats-panel/applications-section. Post-onboarding banner just-onboarded-banner is only visible when navigating from CreatorOnboarding submit (state.justOnboarded=true); it is NOT visible on direct /dashboard visits. State via mongo mutations: slot_booked→appears in upcoming[]; in_payment→appears in in_payment_collaborations[]; inserted payments doc with state=paid→appears in payments[] with creator_payout. Role gating: unauthenticated=401, brand=403, admin=403.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1184 lines — split into modules (auth.py, creators.py, campaigns.py, dashboard.py, seed.py) before adding brand/admin surfaces.
get_creator_dashboard performs 4 sequential mongo calls (profile, collabs, campaigns, brand_profiles, payments) — fine for now but consider aggregation pipelines when volumes grow.

PaymentsSection dedupes items only by id; if a collab is in state=in_payment AND a payments row already exists, the row could appear twice. Not reproducible with current data because backend only surfaces in_payment_collaborations when state==in_payment (never with a payments doc), but tighten this if payment lifecycle is extended.

STATE_META uses 'bg-ember-500/15 text-ember-500 border-ember-500/30' for in_payment — verify 'ember' is a real Tailwind color in this project (it appears to be, based on other components). No visual glitch observed.
OnboardedBanner check uses Boolean(location.state?.justOnboarded); on a hard reload of /dashboard the state is retained by react-router which is arguably a minor bug — but out of scope.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_creator_dashboard.py (new — 8 tests: role gating x3, fresh dashboard shape, full onboarding+apply flow, slot_booked→upcoming, in_payment→in_payment_collaborations, paid payment doc→payments)
test_credentials: Admin creators@wearemonk.in / WeAreMonk@2026 (seeded). Fresh TEST_creator-<rand>@example.com and TEST_brand-<rand>@example.com per run, password Password123!.
seed_data_creation: Test creates fresh users per run. Mongo mutations on collaborations (slot_booked/in_payment) and payments insert are made+reverted within the same test to keep isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Creator Dashboard is fully green. Regression suite: `set -a && source /app/frontend/.env && source /app/backend/.env && set +a && pytest /app/backend/tests -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/all.xml` (35 tests). Onboarding submit requires: name + ig_handle + ig_url + address + >=1 niche (niches are added via chip click or Enter on niche input). Only then does navigate('/dashboard', {state:{justOnboarded:true}}) fire and the banner renders.
